hints: A movie can be watched only if its start is at or after the previous movie's end.
Sort movies by ending time, not starting time.
Repeatedly take the earliest-finishing movie that still fits.
analogy: Finish the current movie as early as possible to leave the largest window for later choices.
example: Movies [3,5), [4,9), [5,8): choose [3,5) then [5,8), so two are watchable.
algorithm: Sort intervals by end time. Select an interval when its start is at least the end of the last selected one.
correctness: For any optimal schedule's first movie, replacing it by the earliest-ending compatible choice leaves at least as much time for every later movie; repeat this exchange argument.
complexity: O(n log n) time and O(1) extra space beyond sorting.
